examShortTricks: Trick 1: Type test: simple (1 clause), compound (2 independent + and/but/or), complex (independent + dependent), compound-complex — count the finite verbs to classify.
Trick 2: Noun clause = subject/object ('what he said'); adjective clause = modifies noun (who/which/that); adverb clause = answers why/when/how — identify function first.
Trick 3: Combining sentences: use relative pronouns for nouns, subordinators for reasons/time — 'because' and 'who' do most of the work.
